name: Bases Read Only
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps the lock on base embeds in hover previews.
Keeps commas inside one lock rule line.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The lock also applies to embedded bases shown in hover previews.
A lock rule with a comma in its path now stays one rule.
tip: With Pro, run "Lock all bases in kiosk mode" to lock every base, also the ones you create later.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Read Only is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
